hook.line: Don Hernando keeps a long mental list of things he cannot stand, and the noise on the street is at the top. Start your own list.

examples.es: Mariana no soporta que la interrumpan.

examples.en: Can't you stand it when they watch you? (to a friend)
I can't stand waiting so long.

examples.es: Odio que Altamira llame cada día.
examples.en: I hate that Altamira calls every day.

rule:
Two ways to say it: *no soporto* and *odio*. Both take a noun, an infinitive, or *que* plus the wish form.

*No soporto el ruido.* A noun.
*Odio hacer fila.* Your own action: infinitive.
*No soporto que me interrumpan.* Someone else's action: *que* plus the wish form.

*Soportar* always comes with *no*. And it's absolute: you can't stand it or you can. For a milder feeling, use *me molesta*.
smallPrint: *Soportar* is "to bear", so *no soporto* is literally "I don't bear". In some places you'll also hear *no aguanto*.

options: I hate it that you stand in line.
I can't stand it that I interrupt them.

yourTurn.prompt: Pick *interrumpen* or *interrumpan* and type the whole sentence: *No soporto que me ___.*
yourTurn.why: After *no soporto que*, the verb takes the wish form: *interrumpan*.

yourTurn.prompt: Type in Spanish: I can't stand the noise.
yourTurn.why: A noun follows straight after: no *que*, no *de*.

yourTurn.prompt: Type in Spanish: I hate standing in line.
yourTurn.why: Your own action, so just the infinitive. *Odio* needs no *no*.

yourTurn.prompt: Type in Spanish: Mariana can't stand being interrupted.
yourTurn.answer: Mariana no soporta que la interrumpan.
yourTurn.why: *Soportar* ends in *-a* for Mariana, and *la* is her.

yourTurn.prompt: Make it about all of us: *No soporto el ruido.*
Type in Spanish: I can't stand waiting so long.
yourTurn.why: It's your own action, so the infinitive follows.

yourTurn.prompt: Type in Spanish: I hate that Altamira calls every day.
yourTurn.answer: Odio que Altamira llame cada día.
accept: No soporto que Altamira llame cada día.
yourTurn.why: Altamira acts, so *que* plus the wish form: *llame*.

pitfalls.why: Almost. After *no soporto que*, the verb takes the wish form: *interrumpan*.

pitfalls.wrong: No soporto un poco el ruido.
pitfalls.why: *No soporto* is absolute, so you can't dial it down with *un poco*. For mild, use *me molesta*.
Almost. When you're the one acting, drop *que* and use the infinitive.

personal: Tell us one thing you can't stand and one thing you hate. For example: *No soporto el ruido.* and *Odio esperar tanto.*
